name: St. Marys
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in St. Marys?
answer_short: Yes. In St. Marys, a PTV may use streets posted 35 mph or less, except Winding Road. State highways are for crossing, not driving along. LSVs follow the 35 mph state rule.

golf_cart.notes: Not Winding Road or state highways

rules.rule: Streets posted 35 mph or less, except Winding Road; state highways only at a marked crossing
Registered LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in St. Marys?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Winding Road in St. Marys?
faq.a: No. The city ordinance bans PTVs on every part of Winding Road.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on a 35 mph city street in St. Marys?
faq.a: Yes, if it is not Winding Road or a state highway.
